headline.t: across marketing spend. I'd build it in

intro: Jetson went from $20M to $100M this year. The posting describes a marketing data lake on Iceberg, dbt, Fivetran and Metabase, with HubSpot feeding it. What's missing is the line from ad spend to closed revenue. I'd build that first, on contract.

chain.d: Spend, pipeline and CAC by channel

timeline.p: HubSpot deals and contacts into the lake through Fivetran.
dbt models that tie ad spend to closed revenue, by channel.
Metabase dashboards the performance team uses for budget calls.

proof.cap: A scoring model I built and put into production.

ask.p: I'd build it while you keep searching. Reply and I'll walk you through it in 15 minutes. If the timing's wrong, just say so.

cta.label: Book a 30-minute call
cta.micro: I'll walk you through the plan for your stack. No pitch.
